overview: Beach Club Villas are Disney Vacation Club rooms attached to the Beach Club, with full access to Stormalong Bay and a short walk to Epcot.
suits: Families who want villa space within walking distance of Epcot.
rooms: As a Disney Vacation Club resort, rooms range from studios with a kitchenette to multi-bedroom villas with a full kitchen and washer and dryer. You don't need to be a member to stay; you can book with cash like a regular hotel.
pools: Guests can use Stormalong Bay and the quieter Dunes Cove pool.
dining: Guests use the Beach Club and Yacht Club restaurants, including Beaches & Cream and Cape May Cafe.
cons: Buses to Magic Kingdom and Animal Kingdom
Fewer villa sizes than some resorts
tips: Walk to Epcot's International Gateway for a quiet entrance.
Use Dunes Cove when Stormalong Bay is crowded.
bestFor: Families who want villa space near Epcot.
